title: PayPal Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: PayPal announced its third quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
SAN JOSE, Calif.


, Oct. 27, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL) today announced its third quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. The earnings release and related materials discussing these results can be found on PayPal's investor relations website at[https://investor.pypl.com/financials/quarterly-results/default.aspx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806663-1&h=2546777431&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4354492-1%26h%3D3163257251%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestor.pypl.com%252Ffinancials%252Fquarterly-results%252Fdefault.aspx%26a%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestor.pypl.com%252Ffinancials%252Fquarterly-results%252Fdefault.aspx&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pypl.com%2Ffinancials%2Fquarterly-results%2Fdefault.aspx) .


PayPal Holdings, Inc. will host a conference call to discuss these results at 5:00 a.m. Pacific time (8:00 a.m. Eastern time) today. A live webcast of the conference call will be available at[https://investor.pypl.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4806663-1&h=3324865640&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4354492-1%26h%3D954579884%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestor.pypl.com%252F%26a%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Finvestor.pypl.com&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.pypl.com) . In addition, an archive of the webcast will be accessible for 90 days through the same link.


**About PayPal**


Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
